instance.finding_key: packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts::dependants map and grid fetch now enumerate every cell of an expanded range on every edit

finding.summary: Dependants map and grid fetch now enumerate every cell of an expanded range on every edit
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts now wrap each formula in `expandUnboundedRanges(...)` before `toSrefs(extractReferences(...))`, and the calculator does `sheet.fetchGridByReferences(references)` on the expanded formula. `toSrefs` materialises one `Sref` per cell in the range, so a single `=SUM(A:A)` on a sheet whose used bounds are thousands of rows adds thousands of dependants-map keys, rebuilt on *every* edit (the docs note "the dependants map is rebuilt on every edit"). Callers of `toSrefs`/`fetchGridByReferences` outside the diff were written for small hand-written ranges. Worth confirming against the largest realistic sheet before shipping.
